budget_declared_before_requests.scope: HyperX QuadCast 2S (9A273AA) only: verify the user-provided DNS product page and its linked PDF as a manual candidate, then formalize a DNS dealer-fallback rule tested on this single row only. No mass DNS crawl, no other catalog row, no Sulpak/Mechta network activity.

host_reasoning.www.dns-shop.ru: The exact product page URL was supplied directly by the user, not discovered or guessed.
host_reasoning.drv.dns-shop.ru: The exact PDF URL was supplied directly by the user (DNS's own driver/manual subdomain, linked from the product page they gave), not guessed.

budget_declared_before_requests.pdf_fetch_mechanism: Stage 8.6's bounded, Range-aware, completeness-classified fetch (complete/partial/unknown_completeness), reused via the same adapted logic as Stage 10.1/10.3/11.1 -- never assumes completeness from a single response.
budget_declared_before_requests.robots_txt_policy: robots.txt fetched first for each host, before any other request to that host, honoring Disallow rules under User-agent: *.
budget_declared_before_requests.identity_verification_requirement: The DNS page and the PDF must each be checked for an explicit statement of model 'QuadCast 2 S' (or equivalent) AND the manufacturer code '9A273AA' before either is treated as evidence for this catalog row. A similar-sounding title alone is not sufficient. Regulatory documents (declarations of conformity, certificates) are not searched for and are not treated as instructions or card material even if encountered incidentally.

dealer_fallback_rule_being_tested_this_s.rule: DNS (dns-shop.ru) may be used as a fallback source for ANY catalog row when official characteristics, photos, or instructions are insufficient. The official source always has priority; on conflict, the field goes to review, not to DNS. Every DNS-sourced field must carry its own URL, provenance, and an exact model/variant check -- a dealer card is never imported wholesale, and identity is never confirmed by a similar title alone.
dealer_fallback_rule_being_tested_this_s.tested_this_stage_on: 9A273AA only -- no other row, no crawl of DNS beyond the two user-provided URLs.
dealer_fallback_rule_being_tested_this_s.existing_restrictions_unchanged: Sulpak stays scoped to its exact LG household-appliance allowlist (washers/dryers, refrigerators, vacuums, microwaves); Mechta stays excluded (official_status=not_allowed, enabled=false). Neither is touched this stage.

stop_conditions: HTTP 403/429/challenge_confirmed on either host -> stop that host, record the gap
redirect off the two allowed hosts -> aborted, not followed
robots.txt disallows the exact page/PDF path -> skip, record why
PDF total size exceeds pdf_max_total_bytes -> stop, report unknown_completeness, do not raise the cap without a separate, explicit revision
explicit_non_goals: No mass DNS census or crawl
No search for declarations of conformity / certificates
No modification of the production registry (source_catalog.v2.json) -- the fallback rule is recorded as a research artifact in this stage's own report directory only

request_log_full.note: exact URL supplied by the user, not guessed

stop_events.401_treated_as: access blocked; not retried with header spoofing or browser automation, per policy
